themes.title: Chi and Chukwu
themes.blurb: Names that speak of God, through Chi, Chukwu or Olisa. Many are whole sentences of thanks or trust.

themes.title: Market-day names
themes.blurb: Names that remember the market day a child was born on, from the four days of the izu.

themes.title: Virtue and blessing
themes.blurb: Names that hold a hope for the child, such as good fortune, a long life or a good path.

themes.title: Family and birth
themes.blurb: Names about the family a child is born into and the way they arrived.

names.meaning: God is so pleasant; God is awesome

examples.en: Chizaram is a name of a person.

names.meaning: Good God; luck; arriving and meeting with luck; encountering luck at arrival (e.g. meeting a friend at table on arrival at his house); a female name [Chioma]

examples.igbo: Ọ gụrụ nwa ya nwoke Chidị.
